page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard3.Flex.32-256 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration belonging to the Standard family. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8358 processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.6 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated physical cores delivering 64 virtual central processing units via two hardware threads per core, combined with 256.0 GB of system memory.

The hardware configuration features a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, providing exactly 4.0 GB of RAM per thread. The server does not bundle local disk storage or discrete graphics processing units, requiring external network-attached block volumes for persistent data storage. One complimentary public IPv4 address is provisioned directly with the instance for networking and ingress connectivity.

Given its dedicated physical compute allocation and proportional memory provisioning, the server balances processing capacity and data handling without over-committing memory. It is suitable for enterprise application hosting, mid-scale databases, continuous integration build nodes, container orchestration, and multi-threaded batch operations.
